actor_type.description: A demand-side agent hailing rides — carries an intrinsic propensity class and origin/destination zones (which steer how fast loyalty is earned and where trips drain supply), plus earned ride_count and loyalty_band that track its lifetime with the market.

A supply-side agent serving trips — carries an intrinsic strategy class and home base zone, plus a mutable current zone that trips and deadheads relocate and a session_rides tally credited as it completes rides.

entity_type.description: A city zone as a first-class record — the spatial grain of the market. Its selection weights steer where riders originate, where trips end, and where drivers are based, and it carries the emitted per-zone demand and supply pressure streams a consumer joins into local surge.

current_state.description: Online and idle at the rank, counting as supply and waiting to be matched to a rider; may log off or reposition if no trip comes.
An idle driver drained away from home deadheading back empty toward its base zone to rejoin the available pool there, diffusing supply back.
Provisionally holding a just-matched dispatch while the driver decides whether to accept the trip or decline and free the rider back to search.
Committed to and carrying out the matched trip, off the supply count until the rider's trip-completion resumes it as available at the destination.
Logged off and left the market; replacement supply arrives as fresh drivers via the log-on stream, so the fleet breathes rather than being a fixed roster.
The trip has begun; the rider is opening its request in its origin zone before the market attempts a match.
Actively scanning for a free driver in its origin zone to claim; this is the pending-demand state the surge signal counts.
Found no free driver and holding on — re-polling in hope of a match while a give-up impulse builds toward abandoning the request.
Matched, with the accepted driver on its way to the pickup — unless the driver declines mid-review, in which case the rider resumes here as declined.
The driver has reached the pickup point; the rider either boards for the ride or fails to show.
Riding to the destination; on completion the ride is credited to both sides' tallies and the driver is relocated to the destination zone.
The post-trip loyalty check where a rider's earned band may climb a tier once its completed-ride count crosses the propensity-gated threshold.
Resting between trips after a good outcome; a satisfied rider that re-entry may recycle into a fresh trip.
The post-bad-outcome loyalty check after a renege, no-show, or decline, dropping the rider's earned band one tier before it lapses.
Left the market after a bad experience; re-entry is still possible but the eroded band makes returning less likely, so bad service drives churn.

journey_type.description: The supply-side lifecycle of a driver — logging on available, being matched and reviewing a dispatch, driving a trip, repositioning home when drained away, and logging off after a quiet stretch.

The demand-side lifecycle of a rider — requesting a trip, seeking and waiting for a match, riding to the destination, then earning or eroding loyalty and either re-riding or lapsing out of the market.

scenario_description: A two-sided ride-hailing marketplace across three city zones: riders (demand) and drivers (supply) are both agents on one clock, tied by an actor-to-actor match and coupled by a surge price signal — wait, match success, spatial supply deserts, surge episodes, and loyalty-driven churn all emerge from the moment-to-moment supply/demand balance rather than being written into the data.

columns.description: The actor's lifecycle stage — trip stages for a rider, online stages for a driver — which the surge signal counts as pending demand (seeking) or idle supply (available).

columns.description: The rider's intrinsic behavioral class, gating how many completed rides it takes to climb into the next loyalty tier.
columns.name: prop__propensity

columns.description: The actor's zone as a zone_market reference — a rider's intrinsic pickup origin, a driver's current location that trips and deadheads relocate; matching pairs riders and drivers sharing this zone.
columns.name: prop__zone

columns.description: The rider's intrinsic trip destination as a zone_market reference; a completed trip relocates the serving driver here, the drain that carves supply deserts.
columns.name: prop__dest_zone

columns.description: Lifetime completed-ride tally, credited once per finished trip; crossing a propensity-gated threshold promotes the rider's loyalty band.
columns.name: prop__ride_count

columns.description: The actor's earned tier, climbing on completed rides and eroding on a renege, no-show, or decline; keys the rider's return probability, and is carried but unread on the driver side for schema parity.
columns.name: prop__loyalty_band

columns.description: The actor's age at signup or logon, carried through for downstream identity enrichment such as date of birth; no simulation rule reads it.

columns.description: The driver's intrinsic behavioral class, a stratification label carried at logon; behavioral differentiation by strategy is a later enrichment.

columns.description: The driver's home zone as a zone_market reference — where it logs on and where an idle deadhead returns it.
columns.name: prop__base_zone

columns.description: Completed-ride tally for the driver's current session, credited once per finished trip through the paired rider's completion mutation.
